```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, fig.width=15, fig.height=10)

library(lubridate)
library(plotly)
library(knitr)
root.dir <- rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir, fig.width=12, fig.height=8)

colors_small <-  c("#9A8822", "#F5CDB4", "#F8AFA8", "#FDDDA0", "#74A089", #Royal 2
                   "#899DA4", "#C93312", "#DC863B" # royal 1 (- 3)
)
colors_full <-  c("#9A8822", "#F5CDB4", "#F8AFA8", "#FDDDA0", "#74A089", #Royal 2
                  "#899DA4", "#C93312", "#DC863B", # royal 1 (- 3)
                  "#F1BB7B", "#FD6467", "#5B1A18", "#D67236",# Grand Budapest 1 (-4)
                  "#D8B70A", "#02401B", "#A2A475", # Cavalcanti 1
                  "#E6A0C4", "#C6CDF7", "#D8A499", "#7294D4", #Grand Budapest 2
                  "#9986A5", "#EAD3BF", "#AA9486", "#B6854D", "#798E87", # Isle of dogs 2 altered slightly
                  "#F3DF6C", "#CEAB07", "#D5D5D3", "#24281A", # Moonriese 1, 
                  "#798E87", "#C27D38", "#CCC591", "#29211F", # moonrise 2
                  "#85D4E3", "#F4B5BD", "#9C964A", "#CDC08C", "#FAD77B" # moonrise 3 
)

```

```{r, include = F}
# use site 006-00
# we need to compile all the Rm6 data
monitoring_location_id <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","2023_UDWC_WQM-ContTemp-_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "Monitoring_Locations")
rm6_2023_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","2023_UDWC_WQM-ContTemp-_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "Results") |> 
  mutate(`Monitoring Location ID` = as.character(`Monitoring Location ID`)) |> 
  left_join(monitoring_location_id |> 
              select(`Monitoring Location ID`, `Monitoring Location Name`)) |> 
  filter(`Monitoring Location Name` == "WC_006-00")  |> # filter for the RM6 site
  glimpse()

rm6_2022_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","2022_UDWC_WQM-ContTemp _FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "Results") |> 
  mutate(`Monitoring Location ID` = as.character(`Monitoring Location ID`)) |> 
  left_join(monitoring_location_id |> 
              select(`Monitoring Location ID`, `Monitoring Location Name`)) |> 
  filter(`Monitoring Location Name` == "WC_006-00") # filter for the RM6 site

rm6_2023_2022 <- bind_rows(rm6_2023_raw,
                           rm6_2022_raw) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  rename(date = activity_start_date,
         temperature = result_value) |> 
  select(date, temperature)

# rm6_2021_raw_1 <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","UDWC_2021_ContinuousDataSubmission_Trimmed_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "WC_006-00 20423312", range = "A5:C1830")
rm6_2021_raw_2 <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","UDWC_2021_ContinuousDataSubmission_Trimmed_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "WC_006-00 20423310", range = "A5:C1040") |> 
  rename(Date = DATE,
         Time = TIME,
         Temp = TEMP_r)


rm6_2020_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","UDWC_2020_ContinuousDataSubmission_Trimmed_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "WC_006-00 20423294", range = "A5:C5092") |> 
  rename(Date = DATE,
         Time = TIME,
         Temp = TEMP_r)

  
rm6_2019_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","UDWC_2019_ContinuousTemperature_TrimmedData_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "WC_006.00_10792864", range = "A5:C4694") |> 
  rename(Date = DATE,
         Time = TIME,
         Temp = TEMP_r)


rm6_2018_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","UDWC_2018_ContinuousDataSubmittal_3.0_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "WC_006-00_354425", range = "A5:C5264") |> 
  rename(Date = DATE,
         Time = TIME,
         Temp = TEMP_r)


rm6_2017_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","UDWC_2017_ContinuousDataSubmittalTemplate_3.0-Final.xlsx"), sheet = "WC_006-00_353753", range = "A5:C3511") |> 
  rename(Date = DATE,
         Time = TIME,
         Temp = TEMP_r)

rm6_2016_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","UDWC-Cont-Temp-2016","WC_006-00.xlsx"), sheet = "354424 Data") |> 
  rename(Temp = `Temp (°C)`)

rm6_2015_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","2015-UDWC-Cont-Temp-Data","WC_006-00.xlsx"), sheet = "354426 Data") |> 
  rename(Temp = `Temp (°C)`)

rm6_2014_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","2014","WC_006-00.xlsx"), sheet = "3544424 Data") |> 
  rename(Date = `Date(yyyy-mm-dd)`,
         Time = `Time(hh:mm:ss)`,
         Temp = `Temperature (°C)`)

rm6_2013_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","2013","WC_006-00.xlsx"), sheet = "353754 Data") |> 
  rename(Temp = `°C`)

rm6_2012_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","2012","WC_006-00.xlsx"), sheet = "4673") |> 
  mutate(Temp = as.numeric(Temp))

rm6_2012_2021 <- bind_rows(rm6_2012_raw,
                           rm6_2013_raw,
                           rm6_2014_raw,
                           rm6_2015_raw,
                           rm6_2016_raw,
                           rm6_2017_raw,
                           rm6_2018_raw,
                           rm6_2019_raw,
                           rm6_2020_raw,
                           rm6_2021_raw_2) |> 
  rename(date = Date,
         temperature = Temp) |> 
  select(date, temperature)

rm6_full_2012_2023 <- bind_rows(rm6_2023_2022,
                                rm6_2012_2021) |> 
  group_by(date) |> 
  summarize(mean = mean(temperature, na.rm = T),
            median = median(temperature, na.rm = T),
            max = max(temperature, na.rm = T),
            min = min(temperature, na.rm = T)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = mean:min, values_to = "temperature", names_to = "statistic")

cp_2015_2019_raw <- readxl::read_xls(here::here("data-raw","camp_polk_2015_2019.xls"))
cp_2023_raw <- readxl::read_xls(here::here("data-raw","camp_polk_2023.xls"))
cp_2022_raw <- readxl::read_xls(here::here("data-raw","camp_polk_2022.xls"))
cp_2021_raw <- readxl::read_xls(here::here("data-raw","camp_polk_2021.xls"))
cp_2020_raw <- readxl::read_xls(here::here("data-raw","camp_polk_2020.xls"))
cp_2019_raw <- readxl::read_xls(here::here("data-raw","camp_polk_2019.xls"))

camp_polk <- bind_rows(cp_2015_2019_raw,
                       cp_2023_raw,
                       cp_2022_raw,
                       cp_2021_raw,
                       cp_2020_raw,
                       cp_2019_raw) |> 
  rename(date = record_date,
         temperature = `instantaneous_water_temp_C¬∞`) |> 
  select(date, temperature) |> 
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) |> 
  group_by(date) |> 
  summarize(mean = mean(temperature, na.rm = T),
            median = median(temperature, na.rm = T),
            max = max(temperature, na.rm = T),
            min = min(temperature, na.rm = T)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = mean:min, values_to = "temperature", names_to = "statistic")

```
# RM 6 temperature data

```{r, warning = F, message = F}

rm6_full_2012_2023 |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = temperature, color = statistic)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_small) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "",
       y = "water temperature at rm6 (celcius)")

```

# Regression

```{r}
dat_full <- full_join(camp_polk |> 
                        rename(cp_temperature = temperature),
                      rm6_full_2012_2023 |> 
                        rename(rm6_temperature = temperature))

dat_full |> 
  filter(statistic == "mean") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = cp_temperature)) +
  geom_line(color = "#9A8822") +
  geom_line(aes(x = date, y = rm6_temperature), color = "#F8AFA8")
```

```{r}
dat_full_mean <- filter(dat_full, statistic == "mean")
# MEAN Regression
split <-rsample::initial_split(dat_full_mean, prop = 0.8)
train <- rsample::training(split)
test <- rsample::testing(split)
cp_rm6_mean_mod <- lm(rm6_temperature ~ date + cp_temperature, data = train)
summary(cp_rm6_mean_mod)
test_predict <- predict(cp_rm6_mean_mod, test)
test_predict_df <- test |>
  mutate(predicted = test_predict)
# evaluate predictions - MAPE of 10% is not bad
# mean(abs((
#   test_predict_df$predicted - test_predict_df$rm6_temperature
# )) / test_predict_df$rm6_temperature)

# plot for mean
ggplot(data = dat_full_mean, aes(x = cp_temperature, y = rm6_temperature)) +
  geom_point() +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(x = "Camp Polk mean water temperature (C)",
       y = "RM6 mean water temperature (C)") +
  theme_minimal()

```
